name: context-bar
description: Context-window usage bar above the prompt, with cost, per-turn growth and rate limits, toggled with /context-bar

accentColor.title: Accent color
accentColor.description: Hex color of the ◆ marks, as #RRGGBB.

compactBarWidth.title: Compact bar width
compactBarWidth.description: Width of the bar in compact mode, in columns (8 to 80).

dockColumns.title: Side dock width
dockColumns.description: Width the side dock asks for, in columns (24 to 120). You can still drag it wider or narrower.

refreshSeconds.title: Countdown refresh
refreshSeconds.description: How often the rate-limit reset countdowns move on, in seconds (10 to 3600).

turnsWindow.title: Turns averaged
turnsWindow.description: How many recent turns the turns-to-compact estimate averages over (1 to 20).

warnPercent.title: Yellow from
warnPercent.description: Share of the window, in percent, at which the badge turns yellow.

dangerPercent.title: Red from
dangerPercent.description: Share of the window, in percent, at which the badge turns red.
